en.headline: Customs seizes 120000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes in retail crackdown
en.dek: Officers posing as customers targeted ten newsstands, grocery stores and convenience shops across the territory and arrested ten people.
body: Customs officers seized about 120,000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes with an estimated market value of HK$540,000 in a territory-wide operation targeting cigarette retail points from 7 to 14 October.

Officers posed as customers at ten outlets in Tuen Mun, Tsuen Wan, Tsing Yi, Kwai Chung, Sham Shui Po, Tsz Wan Shan, Pok Fu Lam and North Point. Ten people aged 26 to 73 — three men and seven women, including shop owners and staff — were arrested.

Customs said some shops sold cigarettes below the statutory duty rate, including so-called “white-label” cigarettes, and that certain overseas brands had no record of having been duty-paid in Hong Kong. The operation remains ongoing and further arrests have not been ruled out.

zh.headline: 海關放蛇檢約12萬支懷疑未完稅香煙 拘10人
zh.dek: 海關喬裝顧客突擊全港10個報檔、士多及雜貨店，檢獲市值約54萬元香煙，拖捕3男7女。
body: 海關由10月7日至14日在全港多區針對香煙零售點採取行動，檢獲約12萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，估計市值約54萬元，應課稅值約40萬元。
人員喬裝顧客在屯門、荃灣、青衣、葵涌、深水埗、慈雲山、薄扶林及北角共10個報檔、士多及雜貨店試購，拖捕3男7女共10人，年齡介乎26至73歲，包括店舖負責人及職員。
海關指部分零售點以低於法定稅率售賣香煙，包括「白牌煙」，部分海外品牌在港並無完稅紀錄。行動仍在進行，不排除再有人被捕。
